title: Omniscient Reader's Viewpoint
altTitles: Omniscient Reader's Viewpoint: The Omniscient Reader's Perspective
読者の視点から見る全知
description: Kim Dokja is an ordinary office worker whose only hobby is reading a web novel called Three Ways to Survive the Apocalypse. After more than a decade of reading, he is the only person who knows how the novel ends. But when the final chapter is released, the world suddenly transforms into the setting of the novel. Armed with his knowledge of the story and the ability to see the world from an omniscient reader's perspective, Kim Dokja must survive the scenarios and change the fate of a world he once only read about.
author: Sing Shong / Sleepy-C
